registration.depth_meaning: unused (pinned to the variety depth maximum); the CACC law has full authority, bounded only by the executor feasibility clip and the 1.2 m/s^2 CAV cap
registration.provenance: CACC gap regulation after Milanes & Shladover 2014 (TR-C 48): a = kp*(gap - s0 - h*v) + kd*(v_pred - v) + kff*(v_pred - v_pred[t-1 V2V packet]); gains/h range chosen by the N9 discrete-time string-stability check (1 s control tick, one-tick feed-forward delay): max_w |Gamma(e^jw)| <= 1 for h in [1.1, 1.4] s (string_gain); kff = 0 is NOT string stable there. s0 = SUMO default minGap 2.5 m. Tighter than the IDM textbook T = 1.5 s. N9 registration for owner review.

platoon_headway.roles: head (front member, no CACC) / follower (CACC on its own sensed member predecessor)
platoon_headway.initiate: free through-lane CAV (WM adjacent/far) with a sensed same-lane CAV leader (role follower) or follower (role head)
platoon_headway.join: free CAV in the session anchor lane whose own nearest same-lane leader (-> follower) or follower (-> head) is in the t-1 roster
platoon_headway.executor: absolute a = kp*(gap - s0 - h*v) + kd*(v_pred - v) + kff*(v_pred - v_pred[t-1 own V2V packet]); offset = a - own native command - frozen base mean (single writer: coop-layer committed offset -> acceleration.requests -> CommandOwnership v + a*1 s); HDV cut-in / non-member predecessor -> offset 0

early_merge.initiate: free closing-lane CAV upstream of the drop (role merge)
early_merge.join: free closing-lane (merge) or adjacent-lane (yield) CAV upstream of the drop within range_m of the initiator
early_merge.executor: merge: lane request closing->adjacent once to_drop <= upstream_m, front-first (no received merge mate ahead still in the closing lane), >= sequence_gap_s after the last completion, <= attempt_s request seconds; yield: offset -depth while a pending merge mate (t-1 packet) is ahead within link_m
early_merge.release: initiator passes the drop (message released) or hold expiry

zipper_order.roles: closing (closing-lane CAV) / through (adjacent-lane CAV); per-role cap (member_cap+1)//2
zipper_order.initiate: free closing- or adjacent-lane CAV with to_drop > zipper_zone_m

zipper_order.executor: fixed interleaved order (order param) by position; a member not yet behind its designated predecessor by s0 + order_headway_s*v eases -depth; closing members request closing->adjacent inside zipper_zone_m when behind the predecessor, ahead of the designated follower and the closing predecessor completed
zipper_order.release: initiator passes the drop or hold expiry

discharge_sync.initiate: free through-lane CAV with v <= queue_speed_mps, |to_drop| <= zone_m and its own leader absent or faster

caveats: All parameter ranges are N9 registrations for owner review (per-family provenance in registration).

Absolute laws (platoon_headway, discharge_sync, harmonize_rows) need each CAV's own native command: v2v_runtime passes it to the protocol; when missing the member gets offset 0 (status native_unavailable).
Joins become visible in the t-1 roster one second after joining; a full session may still be offered for one second (start() rejects over-cap joins on the ledger), as in W1.
early_merge/lane_balance requests repeat for up to attempt_s seconds (gate may refuse); G5 macros stay single-attempt.
No SUMO/GPU run: efficacy and real lane-change execution on wz3to2 are unverified (N3/N4 SUMO checks).
Re-merge N2 after its F6 fix; N2 lane_drop and N9 coexist (separate options, sample keys and receipts).
